name: consec_air_a_hop_poke_into_a_floor_ball_pays_nothing
description: The car drives at 1400 uu/s toward a ball resting on the floor at (-1000, 0, 93) and hops at decision step 8 with boost held, so it is a few tens of uu off the ground when it pushes the ball (touch frames 10-14, car z 57-116, measured). The push lifts the ball: ball z is 112, 133, 151, 166, 178 on frames 10-14, so the ball-height credits are 0, 0, 0.0008, 0.0123, 0.0215 and with the car only 57-116 uu up (car height credit 0.08-0.20) the effective streak peaks at 0.005, nowhere near 1: Phi = 0 throughout and the poke pays nothing. HISTORY: before 2026-11-03 all five contact steps counted (a chain of 5, peak +0.8564 = +34.3 weighted); with a plain 150 uu floor the lifted ball still chained for 3 steps (+0.6289 = +25.2). The car keeps boosting and stays airborne, so there is no landing refund inside the 45 frames shown. Verified independently: a separate script that recomputes the effective streak from the exported on-ground, touched and ball-height values reproduces every step's reward to 1e-7.

expect.intent: the hopping car pushes the ball on frames 10-14
a hop-poke that lifts a floor ball pays nothing (it paid up to +0.86 before the ball-height credit)
